title: Web Technician
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/3514), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: A website your team runs goes down at night. What do you check first, and how do you get it back up?
questions.source: eMASCO 3514, task 1: Memasang, memantau, dan menyokong kebolehpercayaan dan kebolehgunaan laman web Internet dan Intranet atau perkakasan atau perisian pelayan web.

questions.text: Name two security steps you would take on a website you look after, and explain why each one matters.
questions.source: eMASCO 3514, task 3: Membangun, menyelaras, melaksana, dan memantau langkah keselamatan.

questions.text: Tell us about a change you made to a live website. How did you avoid breaking it for users?
